summary_en: 190M shares (2.7% S/O), ¥300B limit. Public tender: ¥150B limit (to be announced separately); open-market purchase: balance of ¥300B less tender amount. Period: 4 Aug 2026–29 Jan 2027. Price ceiling not disclosed. Supports stated ¥300B+ buyback target for FY3/27.
summary_jp: 1億9,000万株（2.7%）、3,000億円上限。公開買付け：1,500億円上限；市場買付け：残額。2026年8月4日～2027年1月29日。FY3/27 3,000億円以上取得方針を実現。
